meta.status_detail: Mechanically migrated 2026-09-18 from the JOURNAL_STYLE_PRESETS dict literal in docs_intel.py (round 2, proposal 64266f13, dated 2026-09-11) as part of the JSON-preset externalization work (proposal 3b93b7ef) -- values and evidence carried over verbatim from the real in-code comment, not regenerated. NOTE (flagged in proposal 64266f13's review section for extra scrutiny -- NOT a substitution caveat, so status stays 'populated' rather than 'partially_populated'): ASME is the other of the two publishers (with asce) called out as directly relevant to the JCSHM thesis domain this preset mechanism originated from. Figure DPI is left unspecified/absent -- the guidance found states figures 'must have sufficient resolution to ensure text readability' without a specific numeric floor.
